Disaster Recovery Instructions
  1. Download a backup - Click the download button next to a backup file to save it locally.
  2. Restore the database - Use the Restore button to replace the current database with a backup. Current data will be lost.
  3. In case of complete failure - Copy the downloaded .sqlite3 file to your server's database location and restart the application.
Best Practice: Schedule regular backups and store copies in a safe, offsite location.
